runtimeMapping.targeting: Native blocked-melee, long-range and own-tile melee ability order, one retained input; source 0-1 grids normalized to runtime pairs.
runtimeMapping.timing: Original selected facing hit events and capped animation rate. Begin/End clip duration gates action; interrupted S2 burst returns to source Skill_2_Idle.
runtimeMapping.s1: Source selected charge, multiplier, light radius/duration and target-free/invisibility fields; detached reveal field begins at shell impact and survives owner retirement.
runtimeMapping.s2: Ten source ammunition charges. Overloaded second trigger captures remaining charges and physical ATK; native attack event consumes ammunition, pays current-HP cost and releases independent missiles. Embedded Arts action uses live ATK.
runtimeMapping.s3: Selected flat attack interval and replacement overload ATK; half-duration transition begins source interval HP loss with linear elapsed-time ramp to the selected max-HP cap. No integer ceiling or SP recovery.
runtimeMapping.talents: Highest native defender ATK aura across deployed Horns; promotion/potential-selected one-time fatal prevention rebases max HP and applies direct self-heal subject to healFree.
runtimeMapping.hud: Separate first-half and overload gauge, red overload phase; source ammo/time fractions and manual-command eligibility.

verificationLimits: Compiled native FSM, event counter and child-projectile dispatcher are not executed. Remaining S2 missiles share the normalized release event; native muzzle staggering and frame order are unverified.
Physical burst ATK is captured at the second command in the adapter; exact compiled native cache initialization phase remains unverified.
Native light projectile flight is normalized into a reveal field at damaging-shell impact; immunity flags are represented by runtime reveal rather than native immunity-index dispatch.
S3 compiled increasing-damage increment and same-frame phase order are unavailable; the adapter uses elapsed overload time and the recovered interval/cap fields.
Aura filter priority, external rebirth priority and native max-HP/current-HP callback ordering remain explicit local mappings.
Original skeleton bytes and clips are verified, but original Unity particles, projectile shapes, audio, modules and game-frame parity are not implemented or certified.
Browser combat review covers S3; S1/S2 browser activation and physical-device touch are not yet verified.
